description: A TIMING probe, not a modelling run: five iterations at the campaign fraction to measure the 9.58/9.59 model's baseline pace (walk-wedge repairs + PassingQ link dynamics + the reverse-complement network) under the declared knobs. The reference point for the other phys_timing2_* probes, which vary one knob group each. Iterations 2-4 are the comparison window (0 pays JIT and cache warmup, the last pays event writing). NOTHING PRODUCED UNDER THIS OVERLAY IS A RESULT.

justification.RUN.controler.last_iteration: The declared sweep starts at 250 because that is the largest value MEASURED to be insufficient for convergence (DECISIONS.md 9.7, 9.43), so the range describes candidate MODELLING runs. This is a wall-clock measurement priced before committing tens of hours to the converged arm's relaunch. The value is deliberately far below the declared range so any output carrying it is obviously not a result.
